from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,json,time,hashlib,sys
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
base=root/'.scratch/backdrop-base'
name=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'final'
output=root/'.scratch'/('backdrop-perf-'+name)
output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
paths=['test/perf/markstream_render_bench.dart','test/perf/timeline_scroll_bench.dart','test/perf/long_streaming_bench.dart','test/support/markdown_backdrop_host.dart']
for path in paths:
 assert (root/path).read_bytes()==(base/path).read_bytes(),path
assert (root/'pubspec.lock').read_bytes()==(base/'pubspec.lock').read_bytes(),'dependency lock mismatch'
metadata={'baseline':'a8364707','sameRevisionControl':name=='control','candidateHead':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),'sdk':subprocess.check_output(['flutter','--version'],cwd=root,text=True),'hardware':subprocess.check_output(['sysctl','-n','machdep.cpu.brand_string'],text=True).strip(),'harnessSha256':{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},'runs':[]}
source_paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','a8364707','--','lib','dependencies/markstream/lib'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines()
metadata['productionSha256']={p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in source_paths if (root/p).is_file()}
(output/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2))
for round in range(1,6):
 for backdrop in (['plain','wallpaper'] if round%2 else ['wallpaper','plain']):
  for bench in (['timeline_scroll','long_streaming'] if name=='control' else ['markstream_render','timeline_scroll','long_streaming']):
   for revision in (['baseline','current'] if round%2 else ['current','baseline']):
    cwd=base if revision=='baseline' or name=='control' else root
    args=['flutter','test','--no-pub',f'test/perf/{bench}_bench.dart','--reporter','expanded']
    if backdrop=='wallpaper':args+=['--dart-define=MARKSTREAM_BENCH_WALLPAPER=true']
    if bench=='markstream_render':args+=['--dart-define=MARKSTREAM_PROFILE_PHASES=true','--dart-define=MARKSTREAM_BENCH_CYCLES=5']
    label=f'{round}-{backdrop}-{bench}-{revision}'
    print('Running '+label,flush=True)
    log=output/(label+'.log')
    start=time.monotonic()
    with log.open('w') as stream:
     result=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env={**os.environ,'MARKSTREAM_RUN':str(round)},stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    text=log.read_text(errors='replace')
    lines=[line for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith(('MARKSTREAM_RENDER ','RESULT ','LONG_STREAM '))]
    entry={'round':round,'backdrop':backdrop,'bench':bench,'revision':revision,'command':args,'exitCode':result.returncode,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'log':log.name,'results':lines}
    metadata['runs'].append(entry)
    (output/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2))
    if result.returncode or not lines:
     print(text[-5000:],flush=True)
     raise SystemExit(result.returncode or 1)
    print(f'Completed {label}: {len(lines)} result rows, {entry["seconds"]:.1f}s',flush=True)
